summary: The bank mostly sounds like DUMMIES: Luxury lines are polished and Corporate lines are procedural. Two lines need correction: a Luxury car shouts, and an Old Market line asserts wet paint the simulation does not guarantee.

issues.fix: "style": "speech", "text": "A calibration plate? I am not a test rig."

issues.found: Old Market damp. Lacquer takes the worst.
issues.rule: A line may only say what the game state guarantees. Old Market puddles are only 4% of the screen, so a district hit does not guarantee damp paint, and the claims list only district:market.
issues.fix: Old Market route. Lacquer takes the worst.
